Thanks again for committing to a short performance evaluation as part of the MAP. Attached is a concise execution plan (redwood_MAP_v2.pdf) that maps milestones to dates and owners. High level asks from our side:

Key received via the secure exchange (thanks). Quick checklist before the run: 

- Harness: we will use the k6 script attached in load_spec.yaml. It exercises: 60% single-turn generator prompts, 30% multi-turn with KV cache usage, 10% embeddings calls.
- Metrics we collect during each step: TTFT, p50/p95 token latency, sustained tokens/sec, memory/GPU util, error rate, and tail-latency distribution.
- Ramp plan (per your throttle note): Warmup 30m @20% load -> Step 1: 100 concurrent sessions for 45m -> Step 2: 200 concurrent sessions for 45m -> Step 3: 400 concurrent sessions for 30m (only if throttle is raised).
- Data to share post-run: results-summary-20260517.csv, per-step traces (traces.tar.gz link in Drive), and a short MAP update that maps metrics to MAP acceptance criteria.

A couple of logistics asks:
- Please whitelist the Redwood benchmarking IPs listed in the Drive doc.
- Provide a contact for on-call infra during the window (we can page if we see 5xx spikes).

I'll hand off to Stephanie to confirm dashboards and the CSV schema for results.
